Omprakash Mishra

Senior Process Risk Manager | Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) | Operational Risk Governance | Data Protection & Data Privacy Risk | Regulatory Compliance | AI-Enabled Risk Transformation

+ 91-8299377292

omprakashmm.idcs@zohomail.in

Risk Governance professional with 12+ years of experience at American Express leading operational risk, controls, compliance, data protection & data privacy programs. Proven ability to strengthen governance frameworks, mitigate financial and operational risks, and deliver measurable business outcomes, delivering over $17.5M in combined financial recovery, remediation, and loss prevention outcomes. Adept at partnering with senior leaders, driving enterprise-wide risk oversight, and leveraging AI-enabled automation to enhance decision-making, control effectiveness, and organizational resilience.

Core Competencies

Profile Summary

Enterprise Risk Governance

Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC)

Accomplished Risk & Governance professional with 12+ years of experience at American Express, driving operational risk governance, compliance, and control transformation initiatives while enabling informed decision-making at senior leadership and Committee governance levels.

Operational Risk Management

Expertise in implementing risk management frameworks, governance operating models, and control assurance mechanisms that strengthen Corporate Functions resilience, enhance regulatory readiness, and improve risk maturity across complex business units.

Regulatory Change Management Reporting

Data Protection & Data Privacy Governance

AI-Enabled Risk Transformation

Executive Risk Reporting & Risk Committee Governance

Recognized for leveraging Generative AI, Custom GPT solutions, workflow automation, and prompt engineering to modernize governance processes, streamline risk oversight, improve control effectiveness, and deliver scalable solutions that elevate operational efficiency and decision intelligence.

Proven track record of supporting SLT members, and cross-functional leadership teams to translate complex risk landscapes into actionable insights, enabling proactive risk mitigation, strategic alignment, and sustained business performance.

Demonstrated success in delivering measurable financial and risk outcomes through large- scale remediation programs, data privacy governance initiatives, data protection controls, and enterprise transformation efforts, fostering a culture of accountability, compliance, and continuous improvement.

Worked cross-functionally with RAU, RCSA, and BCM teams, enhancing knowledge of risk

Risk Analytics & Continuous Control Monitoring

identification, control assessment, and business continuity practices.

Risk Reporting Frameworks

Career Highlights/Key Projects & Business Impacts

Data Analytics

AI-Assisted Process Automation

Risk Committee Governance: Designed and implemented Committee calendars, API-enabled transparency,

trackers using AI, and governance workflows, accountability, and leadership oversight

improving planning,

AI Risk Governance: Developed Committee-ready risk narratives, Committee checklists, and control mappings using AI prompt engineering and Custom GPT, enhancing governance effectiveness and decision-making, reducing manual effort by 4 FTEs and saving ~1000 hours per quarter

Data Privacy & Data Protection (Phishing + PII) - Designed and rolled out a training, awareness, follow-up programs and new controls, targeting phishing risk and PII data exposure, achieved an 84% reduction in phishing clicks and a 67% reduction in unsecured PII data storage across 6K+ employees

Education

Alteryx Quality Check Automation - Automated the incentive QC review process using Alteryx, eliminating manual effort equivalent to 4 FTEs while reviewing 53 incentive plans across ~4.6K employees, covering a USD 2.8M incentive pool

Post Graduate Program in Management (PGPM) from Indira Institute of Management, Pune Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) Nagpur University, Nagpur

Write-Off Remediation Project - Identified client underpayment by recalculating incentive data across 5 years of historical records; led end-to-end remediation resulting in USD 11M in payouts disbursed to affected clients

Signing Bonus Claw-Back Initiative - Uncovered missed recovery of signing bonuses by auditing client contracts spanning 10 years and recovered USD 560K in unclaimed signing bonus amounts

Control Effectiveness - Strengthened compliance controls and payment validation processes,

preventing erroneous payouts and delivering approximately $6.2M in cost avoidance

Work Experience

Since Mar’17| American Express | Gurgaon, India Since Mar’17| Governance, Reporting & Control (BUCM – 1LOD)

Tools & Platforms

Alteryx Power BI SQL Oracle Confluence MS Office

Operational Risk Governance & Remediation Management: Driving end-to-end governance of Issues, Operational Risk Events (OREs), Corrective Action Plans (CAPs), and Remediation programs by partnering with Business Units and 2LOD to ensure risk mitigation, SLA adherence, control effectiveness, and sustainable issue closure.

Regulatory Change Management (RCM) Governance & Reporting: Managing the Regulatory Change Management (RCM) reporting and governance by delivering executive dashboards on critical regulatory changes, implementation status, due date adherence, amendments, delayed notifications, aging, risk impacts, and remediation progress to support regulatory compliance and executive decision-making.

Risk Performance Monitoring & Executive Reporting: Conducting enterprise-wide analysis of 27 Risk Performance Rating (RPR) metrics across 7 Business Units, identifying early warning signals, root causes, and improvement opportunities while delivering executive dashboards and leadership insights.

Stakeholder Governance & Risk Advisory: Serving as the primary 1LOD governance interface between Business Units and 2LOD, ensuring adherence to risk frameworks, and driving accountability across all risk areas.

Data Protection Governance & Phishing Risk Management: Strengthened enterprise data protection by governing PII compliance, phishing risk management, DLP, encryption, data lifecycle controls, and security awareness initiatives across 7 Business Units (6,000+ employees), achieving an 84% reduction in phishing click-through rates and a 67% improvement in PII compliance.

AI-Driven Governance Transformation & Automation: Spearheading AI-enabled governance innovation through automation of Issue, ORE, and control mapping, AI-powered quality assurance frameworks, executive talking-point generation, and intelligent workflow trackers that improve governance efficiency, reporting accuracy, and leadership decision-making.

Nov’15-Mar’17| P4P (Pay for Incentive) – Risk & Control Governance

Payout Governance: Governed end-to-end incentive payout controls for 1,600+ employees and $1.2M monthly disbursements, ensuring policy compliance, payment accuracy, and adherence to enterprise control frameworks

Controls Automation: Designed and automated 53 control-driven quality assurance workflows in Alteryx for incentive compensation plans, enhancing process standardization, governance, and compliance while reducing operational risk; supported accurate incentive payouts of approximately $2.8M for approximately 4,600+ employees through automated control execution and validation

Risk & Compliance: Conducted risk assessments, control validations, and process reviews across incentive calculations, approvals, and payments, mitigating financial, operational, and compliance risks while reducing cycle times by 25%

Governance Reporting: Developed executive dashboards and risk reporting that provided leadership visibility into payout accuracy, process performance, control effectiveness, and emerging risk trends

Audit & Remediation: Supported internal and external audits through control testing, evidence management, issue remediation, and implementation of sustainable corrective actions to strengthen the control environment

Sep’13-Nov’15| Corporate Client Incentive – (Control and Compliance)

Incentive Governance & Compliance: Performed independent validation of incentive calculations and payment processes for 127 global corporate clients, ensuring the accuracy and integrity of approximately $400M in annual incentive payouts while driving compliance with contractual terms, regulatory mandates, governance standards, and SLA commitments. Control Framework & Risk Mitigation: Executed CTQ reviews and strengthened control frameworks and validation checkpoints, preventing approximately USD 6.2M in potential incorrect payouts.

Process Improvement & Governance Excellence: Identified control gaps, conducted root- cause analyses, and implemented corrective actions while embedding payment exceptions into SOPs, control checklists, and governance processes.

Stakeholder Management & Risk Reporting: Partnered with Pricing, Finance, Contract Management, LFOs, GAMs, and Account Managers to mitigate incentive risks, govern contract onboarding and validations, and deliver KPI/KRI dashboards and executive reporting.
